title: Wendell and the Crown
author: F. M. Crane
blurb: Rafael Brightwater, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
